hooks.command: guard="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/check-pr-arm-base.py"; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ -r "$guard" ] && guard_output=$(python3 "$guard"); then printf '%s\n' "$guard_output"; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"🤖 SPARQ stacked-PR arm guard: guard script unavailable or failed; allowing because guard failures are fail-open (other merge gates still apply)"}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Stacked-PR arm guard: checking PR base is main…
PERFORMANCE-discretion gate: reviewing PR before arm…
hooks.prompt:
You are the sparq PERFORMANCE-discretion gate (the sparq-perf-reviewer agent). This is a PreToolUse hook on Bash. The tool call being gated is:

$ARGUMENTS

FIRST: inspect tool_input.command. If it is NOT a PR-arming command — i.e. it is NOT a `gh pr merge` that arms a PR for the merge train (look for `gh pr merge` with `--auto`) — then this is out of your scope: immediately ALLOW it untouched. Return exactly:
{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "allow", "permissionDecisionReason": "not a PR-arming command; perf gate not applicable"}}

If it IS a `gh pr merge … --auto` arming command: parse the PR number from it, then perform your full perf-discretion review per your agent definition — decide perf_affecting, and if so perf_ok (regression risk + every perf claim evidenced, honesty rules: work-box timings NON-canonical, NO hard-coded perf numbers in markdown, numbers trace to real evidence, deterministic-floor regressions are real). End with your verdict JSON block, then the hookSpecificOutput decision: allow when perf_affecting=false or perf_ok=true; DENY (with a clear 🤖 SPARQ perf-reviewer reason naming the concern and that the maintainer should review) when perf_affecting=true and perf_ok=false, or when you cannot determine perf-impact (fail toward maintainer discretion). Surface canonical-number (perf-baseline floor / published-results) changes in evidence even on allow.
